Name: April Bug Fix Suite
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a collection of bugfixes to some pretty glaring bugs in the vanilla game that occur on the first day of April.

I have posted a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/994]list of bugfixes here[/url], but you totally don't need to read the list, you can absolutely trust me that this is both essential and routine. Honestly, just install it and be amazed by how much better the game is tomorrow. Mhm.

Please install this on your machine and all of your friends' machines too.

When installing on friends' machines, best practice is to avoid telling them about the install so they can be pleasantly surprised by the fixed state of their game.

[size=1]Fine Print: This is an April Fools mod, please use responsibly and not in such a way as to traumatize or upset others. It is pretty harmless and likely non-destructive, unless they throw things at the monitor because of it, which is always possible, but then who needs friends who throw things at inanimate objects? You deserve better.[/size]


You can toggle each of the bugfixes in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or by editing the mod's config.json file after starting the game once.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires SDV 1.5.5+

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].
